# Tumbletub

> A calm bath-toy physics puzzle for iPhone, coming soon to the App Store. Plan the fizz. Wait for the plop. This file holds the full text of https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tumbletub-site/ (home, support and privacy pages) as Markdown.

## Home — Plan the fizz. Wait for the plop.

Source: https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tumbletub-site/

A bath-toy physics puzzle for iPhone. Place numbered fizz balls on bath toys, press Fizz!, and let the foam push every toy into the water. Nothing moves until you are ready, so take as long as you like to plan.

96 calm levels. The first 24 are free.

Status: coming soon to the App Store. iPhone only. There is no App Store link yet. "Email me at launch" opens an email to lamnv260398@gmail.com; send it and we will write back when Tumbletub is on the App Store. No sign-up form, no mailing list.

Tired of puzzle games that stop you for an ad or make you wait to play again? What you will not find: no ads, no lives or energy, no tracking, no account.

Screenshots: the home screen (the Bathtub room with its 24-level grid, three more rooms and a Run the bath button), and Kitchen Sink level 3-11 (two rubber ducks on a teak shelf and a sponge on the counter, with fizz balls 1 and 2 placed beside them above a basin of water, and the Fizz! button below).

### How it plays

Each level is a still life of bath toys on teak shelves above the water. You get a few fizz balls and one plan.

1. **Place.** Tap a glowing ring on a bath toy to place a numbered fizz ball. Place one, or several.
2. **Fizz!** Press Fizz! The balls pop in number order, and the foam pushes everything nearby away from each ball.
3. **Plop.** Get every toy into the water. Anything that lands on the floor loses the level, and a piece marked with a crossed-out drop must stay dry.

Start over is always free. Rewind (undo the last Fizz!) and Extra Fizz (one more ball) are earned by clearing levels 6, 12, 18 and 24 of a room for the first time.

### Fair by design

You pay once for the rooms you want, and that is the whole deal.

- **Helpers are earned, not sold.** Rewind and Extra Fizz come from clearing levels, never from the Shop.
- **Progress stays on your iPhone.** It is saved on the device only, with no account behind it.

Rooms and prices:

| Room | Levels | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Bathtub | 24 | Free |
| Laundry Room | 24 | $1.99 |
| Kitchen Sink | 24 | $1.99 |
| Garden Pool | 24 | $1.99 |
| Whole House | all 3 paid rooms, save $1.98; only before you buy any room | $3.99 |

One-time purchases, no subscriptions. Restore them any time from Settings or the Shop. The App Store shows prices in your own currency.

### Be there on launch day

Tumbletub is coming soon to the App Store for iPhone. The Bathtub and its 24 levels are free from day one. Email me at launch: lamnv260398@gmail.com.

## Support

Source: https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tumbletub-site/support.html

### Contact

Write to lamnv260398@gmail.com. Please say which device you play on and, if it is about a level, its number.

### How to play

1. **Place.** Tap a glowing ring on a bath toy to place a numbered fizz ball. Place one, or several.
2. **Fizz!** Press Fizz! The balls pop in number order, and the foam pushes everything nearby away from each ball.
3. **Plop.** Get every toy into the water. Anything that lands on the floor loses the level, and a piece marked with a crossed-out drop must stay dry.

Helpers:

- **Start over** is always free.
- **Rewind** undoes the last Fizz!
- **Extra Fizz** gives you one more ball.
- Rewind and Extra Fizz are earned by clearing levels 6, 12, 18 and 24 of a room for the first time. They are never sold.

### Purchases

The Bathtub and its 24 levels are free. The Laundry Room, Kitchen Sink and Garden Pool rooms (24 levels each) are one-time purchases (non-consumable): $1.99 each. The Whole House gets all 3 paid rooms for $3.99, saving $1.98, and is offered only before you buy any room. The App Store shows prices in your currency. Bought something before, or on another device with the same store account? Open Settings → Restore purchases or Shop → Restore purchases.

### Progress

Progress is saved on the device only. It is not synced between devices, and it is removed if you delete the app.

## Privacy Policy

Source: https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tumbletub-site/privacy.html

Last updated November 10, 2026.

Tumbletub is a puzzle game. It does not ask who you are, and it does not sell any data about you.

### What stays on your device

- Your progress: stars per level, the Rewind and Extra Fizz helpers in stock, and which store purchases were already delivered.
- Your settings: the Sound switch.
- Whether you have bought the Laundry Room, Kitchen Sink, Garden Pool or Whole House rooms.

This is stored on your device only. Deleting the app removes it.

### What we do not do

- No account or sign-in.
- No advertising and no ad networks.
- No analytics, crash reporting or tracking of any kind.
- No access to your contacts, photos, location, camera or microphone.

### Purchases

The Bathtub and its 24 levels are free. Purchases are handled entirely by the App Store under its own privacy policy. We receive no payment details; the game only learns from the store which purchases exist.

### Children

The game collects no personal information from anyone, including children.

### Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.

### Questions

Write to us through Tumbletub support: https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tumbletub-site/support.html
